subject: Recap + benchmark links: model fit & Redwood-verified perf profiles
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Recap + next steps — model fit & evals

Hi Chris / Natalie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Discovery notes (high level):
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + routing (short to mid-length responses, 64–256 tokens).
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for 64-token responses; p95 < 500ms for 256 tokens.
- Throughput target: 300–500 requests/sec during peak (multi-region).
- Data/security: must support VPC/private deployment for sensitive data; audit logs + SOC2 evidence required.
- Quality tolerance: high precision on intent classification; acceptable slight degradation in open-ended summarization but need measurable evals.

Initial model candidates (to evaluate with your prompt sets):
- Mistral-7B-instruct (fp16) — good cost/latency sweet spot for routing/classification.
- Llama-2-13B-chat (8-bit quant) — strong conversational baseline, better instruction following.
- Redwood-52B-quant (our optimized 52B variant) — higher quality for summarization, higher cost; useful as a fallback/ensemble.

Next steps I committed to:
1) Share Redwood-verified benchmark links and a short summary (TPS, latency p50/p95/p99) for the candidate models using your expected payload and prompt set.
2) Share the prompt sets template + a sample evaluation notebook (drive link).
3) Outline canary rollout + quality-regression monitoring (evals + automatic rollback).
4) Schedule a short follow-up (30m) after you review the benchmarks — propose Wed/Thu next week.

I'll follow up with the benchmark summary and links by Thursday. If you want anything else included in the benchmark (e.g., different batch sizes, KV-cache reuse for multi-turn), let me know.

Best,
Alex Martinez

Two quick asks before you run the benchmarks:

Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — benchmark links + perf summary

Hi Chris / Natalie —

Per promise, attached is a short benchmark summary (PDF) and the prompt sets we discussed (XLSX). Quick notes and the Redwood-verified perf profiles below — all runs were executed against our hosted benchmark environment on A100/80GB equivalents with network emulation to approximate a us-west region setup. Full raw logs and the eval notebook are in the Drive link below.

Redwood-verified performance profiles (representative, averaged over 3 runs):

Model: Mistral-7B-instruct (fp16)
- Definition: TPS = requests/sec (128-token avg response)
- Throughput: 520 requests/sec (single-region, continuous batching)
- Latency: p50=45ms, p95=180ms, p99=310ms
- Notes: best cost/latency; excellent for classification/routing.

Model: Llama-2-13B-chat (8-bit quant)
- Throughput: 310 requests/sec
- Latency: p50=75ms, p95=340ms, p99=620ms
- Notes: stronger instruction following; slightly higher p99 tail.

Model: Redwood-52B-quant (optimized 52B variant)
- Throughput: 95 requests/sec
- Latency: p50=210ms, p95=460ms, p99=780ms
- Notes: highest quality for summarization; recommend as a canary/fallback for complex multi-sentence summarization.

Quality regression monitoring / canary runbook (summary):
- Evals: we run prompt-set-based evals on every canary release and nightly on production traffic samples. Golden set metrics: ROUGE/EM/intent-accuracy + custom heuristics (e.g., hallucination-rate).
- Alerts: threshold-based alerts on metric drift (example: >3% drop in intent-accuracy or >5% ROUGE drop triggers an alert). Alerts post to Slack + PagerDuty for on-call SRE.
- Rollback: automated rollback policy available — if canary crosses thresholds, traffic is re-routed to a previous model variant and a rollback ticket is opened automatically.
- Example link: sample eval notebook and alert config are in the Drive folder.

Files attached / links: 
- 20260618-NovaCorp-benchmark-summary.pdf (PDF) — concise TPS + latency tables and experiment knobs.
- novacorp_prompt_sets.xlsx (XLSX) — your prompt sets template + example cases.
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cNovacorpPromptSets
- Benchmarks page: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/novacorp-DEAL-2026-0421
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/102030/DEAL-2026-0421

Next steps I propose:

- If you agree, we'll also schedule a Dedicated evaluation run on your private VPC for data residency tests next week.

Let me know if that's good and I'll send a calendar invite.
